services.name: Corporate Events
services.desc: With a capacity for up to 600 guests among our various event spaces, we can create a welcoming environment for any size company event. Our facility boasts a mix of indoor and outdoor spaces that can accommodate a formal sit-down dinner, working meeting, or casual happy hour. The 3,500-square-foot grand ballroom for 300 guests has elegance to spare, with coffered ceilings, chandeliers, stone pillars, and custom sliding iron doors. The full prep kitchen has plenty of room for your caterer and includes a walk-in refrigerator, on-site ice machine, food warmer, and dedicated restroom for staff.
